inputs.legend: Fields marked “Check this” are assumptions. Replace them with your own figures.
note.fuelPriceCity: {city}, as of {date}. Changes daily; check your pump.
note.fuelPriceExample: Example price. Changes daily; check your pump.
note.mileage: Assumption: use your car’s real-world figure, not the brochure.
note.extraPrice: Assumption: the CNG variant’s premium over petrol, including on-road add-ons. Use your dealer quote.
note.interestRate: Your loan rate, or what the money would earn elsewhere. Compounded monthly (rate ÷ 12).
note.cngUpkeep: Optional, e.g. cylinder testing and kit servicing. 0 means ignore.
note.horizon: Used for the chart, the table and the long-run view.
